description: Beats, tempo, and onsets by Essentia's RhythmExtractor2013 (multifeature) and OnsetRate on 44,100 Hz audio in overlapping chunks, and how far onsets sit from the beat grid. Decodes for itself: both algorithms need 44,100 Hz and finer hops than frames has.

beats.description: the tracker's beats moved onto the onsets' time base, each with an onset within beat_align_ms or onsets within beat_gate_seconds on both sides

onsets.description: OnsetRate's onsets, but none in the first edge_onset_ms; 4 to 15 ms before the attack, by its sharpness

tempo.description: 60 over the median beat interval in the window; 0 where none

onset_count.description: onsets in the window between two beats

onset_deviation.description: mean absolute and mean signed distance of those onsets from the subdivided beat grid, the beats aligned to the onsets on them; positive is late

offgrid.description: mean absolute distance as a fraction of a subdivision: about 0.03 on the grid, 0.25 at random, 0.5 at most

chunk_confidence.description: BeatTrackerMultiFeature's confidence of each chunk, 0 to 5.32; 0 for a chunk that keeps no onset; the last chunk may be shorter than the grid's frame

bpm.description: 60 over the median of every beat interval; 0 with fewer than two beats

confidence.description: the chunks' confidences weighted by the seconds each keeps
